items.headline: Camp opens with an intense, detail-heavy first practice
items.summary: Sean Sweeney's first Magic practices ran Tuesday, with defensive installation in the morning and offensive sets in a non-contact evening session. Franz Wagner called it very organized and very intense. No new transactions or injury designations have been reported.

bullets.text: Wagner: "Every drill is scheduled to the second pretty much. It's very intentional and very intense." Paolo Banchero said the new terminology takes adjustment but should turn the defense up.
Camp runs through Oct 6 (off Oct 3). Preseason opens Oct 7 at Memphis.
Nelson is still recovering from July ankle surgery; team president Jeff Weltman has said he is about a month from live play. Isaac said he will not be fully unrestricted at the start of camp.
Camp roster stays at 20, including Exhibit 10 players Malaki Branham, J.D. Davison and Kevin Knox II.
No Anthony Black extension yet; the rookie-scale deadline is Oct 19.

items.watch: Next up: more camp practices, then preseason at Memphis Oct 7.

items.headline: Media day done: Banchero slimmer, Nelson out to start
items.summary: Media day is complete and training camp opens Tuesday, Sept 29. Coach Sean Sweeney's staff set player roles before media day, and Paolo Banchero looked slimmer and stronger after his offseason work. Izaiyah Nelson (ankle) will not be ready for the season start, and Jonathan Isaac is still hoping to be ready for the Oct 21 opener. No transactions or extension news.

bullets.text: Per Magic On SI's media day coverage, Izaiyah Nelson (ankle) will not be ready for the season start and Jonathan Isaac (knee) is still hoping to be ready for the opener. Franz Wagner said Sept 27 he feels fully healthy but remains officially questionable on CBS's injury page.
Sweeney's staff met before media day to define every player's role for the season, a change from past years, with flexibility to adjust. Banchero appeared slimmer and stronger.

BetMGM has posted a line for the Oct 21 season opener at home against Atlanta: Magic -2.5 (-110), moneyline -135. Season-long futures are unchanged: Southeast Division +250, Eastern Conference +2500, NBA title +8000.
Camp roster holds at 20, unchanged since Kevin Knox II's Exhibit 10 signing Sept 23. No cuts expected until camp trims the roster later this week.
No Anthony Black extension yet, with the Oct 19 rookie-scale deadline three weeks away.
Training camp opens tomorrow, Sept 29, running through Oct 6 (off Oct 3). Preseason opens Oct 7 at Memphis.

items.watch: Next up: training camp opens tomorrow, Sept 29, then preseason at Memphis Oct 7.

items.headline: Quiet Sunday: Weltman stands pat, media day tomorrow
items.summary: No transactions, injury changes or extension news since Saturday. A Yahoo Sports preview says GM Jeff Weltman is sticking with the core (only real addition was Nikola Vucevic) and expects Sean Sweeney's hire to produce immediate results, even as the East got tougher with Philadelphia, Boston and Indiana all improving. Media day is tomorrow morning, with camp opening Tuesday.

bullets.text: Jeff Weltman avoided blockbuster moves this offseason, betting on the existing young core rather than a shakeup; Nikola Vucevic's return was the only notable addition. A Yahoo Sports preview frames Sean Sweeney's hire as a bet on immediate improvement, not a rebuild (Yahoo Sports, Sept 27).
The same preview notes the East got harder to climb: the champion Knicks, Philadelphia, Boston and Indiana are all seen as improved, raising the bar for Orlando's playoff push.
Camp roster still stands at 20, unchanged since Kevin Knox II's Exhibit 10 signing Sept 23. No cuts expected until camp opens Sept 29.

Franz Wagner (calf) and Jonathan Isaac (knee) remain questionable for the start of the season on the official injury report, unchanged since Sept 8. Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery) remains out until at least Nov 1.
No Anthony Black extension yet, with the Oct 19 rookie-scale deadline just over three weeks away.
Media day is tomorrow, Monday Sept 28 at 11 AM ET, with training camp opening Tuesday, Sept 29. Preseason opens Oct 7 at Memphis.

items.headline: Sweeney: Banchero and Wagner set the tone this summer
items.summary: Sean Sweeney praised Paolo Banchero and Franz Wagner's offseason work habits, a day after crediting Desmond Bane's leadership and Jalen Suggs' effort. No transactions, injury changes or extension news since Wednesday. Media day is Monday morning, with camp opening Tuesday.

bullets.text: Sean Sweeney said Banchero and Wagner have been enjoyable to be around, calling their work habits exemplary and saying their actions have let their voices resonate with teammates and coaches (Yahoo Sports, Sept 26). It follows Thursday's comments praising Desmond Bane's leadership and Jalen Suggs' offseason effort (HoopsHype).
Camp roster still stands at 20, unchanged since Kevin Knox II's Exhibit 10 signing Sept 23. No cuts expected until camp opens Sept 29.

items.headline: Quiet Friday: camp roster set, media day three days out
items.summary: No new Magic transactions, injury updates or scheduling news since Wednesday's Kevin Knox II signing. The 20-man training camp roster stands pat heading into media day Monday and the start of camp Tuesday. Franz Wagner and Jonathan Isaac remain questionable for the season and Anthony Black still has no extension.

bullets.text: Camp roster holds at 20 players, one below the offseason limit. No moves since Kevin Knox II's Exhibit 10 signing Wednesday.

Franz Wagner (calf) and Jonathan Isaac (knee) are still questionable for the start of the season on the official injury report, unchanged since Sept 8. Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery) remains out until at least Nov 1.

items.headline: Magic add Kevin Knox II to camp roster on Exhibit 10 deal
items.summary: Orlando's 20-man training camp roster is set, one shy of the offseason limit, after signing forward Kevin Knox II on Wednesday. Unlike the four players signed and waived earlier in the week, Knox is staying in camp to compete for a roster spot. No change yet on Franz Wagner or Jonathan Isaac's status, and Anthony Black still has no extension with the Oct 19 deadline approaching.

bullets.text: Kevin Knox II, the No. 9 pick in 2018, signed an Exhibit 10 deal Sept 23 and will wear No. 24. He averaged 22.7 points, 8.2 rebounds and 2.5 assists for Windy City in the G League last season and will compete for a camp spot rather than being waived immediately.
The camp roster is now 20 players, one below the offseason limit, with media day Monday and camp opening Sept 29.
Franz Wagner (calf) and Jonathan Isaac (knee) remain questionable for the start of the season on CBS's injury page, unchanged since Sept 8. Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery) is out until at least Nov 1.
Still no Anthony Black extension with the Oct 19 rookie-scale deadline three and a half weeks away.

items.watch: Next up: media day, Monday Sept 28 at 11 AM ET.

items.headline: Four camp signees quietly routed to Osceola's G League roster
items.summary: A quiet Wednesday before camp. Orlando signed and waived four Exhibit 10 players this week purely to secure their G League rights for Osceola; the actual 14-man standard roster is unchanged. Franz Wagner and Jonathan Isaac remain questionable for the season opener with no new team update, and Anthony Black still has no extension four weeks from his Oct 19 deadline.

bullets.text: The Magic signed Ace Baldwin Jr., Ricky Council IV, Jarron Cumberland and Au'Diese Toney to Exhibit 10 deals and waived all four the same day, a routine move that locks up their returning-player rights for Osceola. It does not change the real training camp roster.

Franz Wagner (calf) and Jonathan Isaac (knee) are still listed questionable for the start of the season on CBS's injury page, unchanged since Sept 8. No team statement yet; expect one at media day Monday. Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery) is out until at least Nov 1.
Still no Anthony Black extension. Bleacher Report projects the Magic will let the Oct 19 deadline pass and revisit it in restricted free agency next July, citing the team's tax bill and apron limits.
Position battles to watch: starting center (Wendell Carter Jr. vs Nikola Vucevic), Noah Penda vs Tristan da Silva, and whether Suggs keeps the starting point guard job over Black.
14 standard contracts, with the 15th spot likely to stay open to save tax money. Malaki Branham and JD Davison remain in camp on non-guaranteed Exhibit 10 deals.

items.watch: Next up: media day, Monday Sept 28 at 11 AM ET.

items.headline: Six days to media day, and health is the first question
items.summary: A quiet Tuesday before camp. The Magic hold media day Monday and open training camp under new head coach Sean Sweeney on Sept 29. NBA.com's season preview says getting Franz Wagner (34 games last season) and Jalen Suggs (57) healthy is the top priority. Anthony Black still has no extension, with the Oct 19 deadline four weeks away.
items.watch: Next up: media day, Monday Sept 28 at 11 AM ET.
